source.implements: Game tab state: battle round 1–5 (Event Companion 13: five battle rounds), the first or second turn of the round (07.02: both players take one turn each, the same player first every round), who takes the first turn (Event Companion 10), the phase, both players' CP and VP, the picks; a stored value out of range reads as a new game
New game (the Game tab's and the Overview's, which share it): clears this game (round, turn, CP, VP, choices) and the uses per battle of both lists of the game, with Undo

judgement.code: const GC_SEL = /\b(?:select|activate)\s+(one|up to two|up to three)\b([^.]*)/gi;

source.implements: a rule that has the player pick one of its options: "select one" / "activate up to two" (Blessings of Khorne)

how long a pick lasts, from the rule's words: the battle ("until the end of the battle", "for the coming battle"), the battle round ("until the end of the battle round", "until the start of the next battle round", "until the start of your next Command phase"), or until another is picked ("remains in that protocol until it enters a different one")
the options a section ability lists as bold-named parts ("**Mantra of Discipline:** …", its "- " lines with it)
the options a rule lists as its own bullets ("- **Protector Protocol:** …", "- Select one enemy unit. …")

the options in a rule's table: "Deed 1–2 · …" is option 1–2 of the Deeds (Code Chivalric: a Deed and a Quality, each by D6 result), otherwise each row is one option ("Unbridled Bloodlust · double 1+")

where a choice's options are: its table when its words point at it ("below", or a group of its rows: "select one Deed"); the abilities of the section it names ("the abilities in the Crimson King section", "one Wrathful Presence ability": abilities whose who is that name), or the bold-named parts of the ability of that name (Icon of War, Canticles of the Omnissiah); its own bullets ("of the following", "listed below")
when a pick is made, quoted from the rule: the start of the sentence that has the player select, else the first "at the start/end of …" or "in your … phase" it names, else its at tag

the choices a list's rules ask for this game: army rules (not inert), detachment rules (a unit it applies to), unit abilities (one per unit copy); kept only when the rule says how long the pick lasts and its options are found; an option of another choice of the same unit is not a choice itself; chosen or rolled ("randomly select"), the state the rule names ("your army becomes Honoured"), each option once per battle ("select each of these abilities once per battle"), up to two
which pick is shown: the battle's, this battle round's, or for a pick kept until changed the last one made in this or an earlier battle round

a picked option that has the player select a unit of the opponent's army ("select one CHARACTER model in your opponent's army", "select one enemy unit", "select one unit from your opponent's army"): their units (with that keyword) to pick from, when their list is picked

judgement.code: const G_STEP = /^(?:\((?:once|twice) per [^)]*\) )?(?:(?:once per [a-z ]+|if your army faction is [^,]+), )?(?:at )?(?:the )?(start|end) of (?:(your opponent[’']s |your |the |each |every |any )?(command|movement|shooting|charge|fight) phase|(?:your opponent[’']s |your |the |each |a )?(first battle round|battle round|battle|turn|phase))\b/i;

source.implements: the step of a phase a rule's own first words name: "(Once per battle,) at the start/end of (your / your opponent's / the / any) <phase> phase", or of the battle round, the first battle round, the battle, a turn (Core 07–12: start of the phase, the phase's own steps, end of the phase)

a rule's step in a phase: an at of "Start of the battle round" → Start of Battle Round (07.01); an at of "End of … turn" → the end of that turn; otherwise G_STEP on its words (a phase it does not name: during the phase)
a rule with no phase tags: the phase and turn its first words name ("At the end of your opponent's turn": their turn, at the end of it)

what a list can do in a phase of a turn: its army rules (not inert) and detachment rules (a unit they apply to) by their phase tags and their reminders' tags, its units' abilities (not the ones that cannot be used in the list, not Damaged profiles) and its stratagems, read from ph/phases, turn/turns and at; what is triggered at the start of the battle round (and, in the first, of the first battle round and of the battle) is shown in the round's first Command phase for both lists whatever their turn tags (07.01: start-of-round rules are resolved before the player turns); in a later Command phase such a rule is shown only when its words after the first sentence name the Command phase; a rule for all five phases is "Any phase"

how a phase is laid out: Start of the battle (round 1) and Start of Battle Round (07.01) in the round's first Command phase, then the phase's start step, Gain Core CP (08.02) after the Command phase's start (08.01), the phase's own steps (during), its end step; the end of the turn after the Fight phase's end, End of Battle Round (07.03) after the round's last Fight phase; stratagems after rules and abilities in each step, the ones no unit can use last

a phase's rows: each opens its full text (the other list's from that list); a stratagem's gist, and which units can use it only when none can; uses per battle as the Overview's ticks (the same keys); an option of a choice marked picked / not picked this round, a choice's current pick
a sentence that gives CP: "gain(s) … CP / Command Point(s)"
the rules of a list that give CP, quoted by that sentence (not their FAQ or errata lines): army rules (not inert), detachment rules, unit abilities (usable in the list), each once with its units

judgement.code: const gEvery = (L, test) => inArmy(L, () => L.units.filter(u => unitRules(u).some(test) && !(u.partialRules || []).some(test)));

source.implements: units with Deep Strike, Scouts or Infiltrators: only when every model of the unit has it (24.09, 24.31; Infiltrators: "if every model in a unit has this ability"), as the Overview counts them

the Event Companion's mission sequence with both lists' numbers: step 7 the strategic reserves limit (20.01: 50% of the points limit for the battle size, worked out from each list's points limit, marked as an app note) and the units with Deep Strike; step 8 the TITANIC units (its TITANIC sentence set apart when a list has one) and the Infiltrators; step 10 who takes the first turn; step 11 the units with Scouts

a choice: its rule, when the pick is made and how long it lasts, its options (an option picked in another battle round of a once-per-battle choice marked used), Rolled, the state (Honoured), the quoted text of each pick, their unit, earlier rounds' picks; an app note when its timing names a step the Event Companion's mission sequence does not have ("the Read Mission Objectives step")

a pick: one option (tapped again: none), with up to two a third replaces the first; Rolled, the state and their unit on and off; picking an option of a once-per-battle choice (Kindred Sorcery) ticks the Overview's box for it, unpicking it unticks it unless another battle round picked it
